tools.name: search_coloring_pages
tools.description: Search currently published Huebloom coloring pages by English topic keywords. Returns bounded previews and source links. Use get_coloring_page for a selected PDF download. Age and difficulty are not verified filters.

tools.name: get_coloring_page
tools.description: Get a public coloring page by its exact slug from search results, including preview, original source, PDF download link and licensing policy. Does not download PDF bytes.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List visible collections, optionally filtered by group. Supply both group and category to browse that collection’s actual active page feed. Counts represent distinct pages in that feed. Use returned identifiers verbatim.
